verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. In both, 'Every mixed case.' is forced into a narrow three-line stack. The product is shrunk to a tiny tile on a purple disc, and its label can't be read. 'Ends Sunday. Online only.' is jammed about 4–5px from the disc's edge, with a dead empty strip on the right. 'WEEKEND ONLY' is so small it's hard to read. A leaves slightly more gap around the button and B is a few pixels tighter, but the difference doesn't matter.
